scope: Single seed0 CIFAR100 alpha0.05. T8 latest common evaluated stage. T9 only control/full. Historical references are original-system comparisons, not matched mechanism ablations.

definitions.AIA: mean all-seen stage accuracy over T1 through reported Tn; never substitute T10 AIA
definitions.forgetting: mean(max accuracy before Tn - accuracy at Tn) over previous tasks; no nonnegative clipping
definitions.S: correct within true task block but another task wins globally; W+S=global errors

stop.reason: Explicit user stop; training and monitoring remain paused.
stop.counter_scope: Last persisted PROGRESS snapshot; may lag last event/checkpoint. Task and round are zero-based.

gates.T3_reload: passed all three arms, 3000 images raw/centered predictions identical

limitations: T4-T9 metrics are saved contemporaneous evaluations, not separately checkpoint-reload-qualified endpoints.
MVP T9 training complete but no T9 metric; do not fill missing values or compare different stages.
T3 mechanism/cost diagnostics are scoped to T3, not extrapolated to T8/T9 or exit.
No late-stage paired per-image corrections/destructions, full mechanism/cost audit, or T10 results are claimed.
Full changes dynamic subspace, accumulated effective rank and random stream; Full-control does not isolate spectral transport.
Single seed, known historical comparison, user-interrupted run; no statistical significance or complete-run success claim.
No training/evaluation rerun, automatic continuation or monitor reactivation authorized by this report request.
